slides.h: One argument in the ten past five reading does not hold
b: And it was the one I put the most weight on.

slides.h: A ratio of exactly 2 — and then a claim that does not follow
b: Hawking temperature for this model: 1.3 times 10 to the minus 30 degrees. Ordinary cosmology already predicts 2.7 times 10 to the minus 30 for its own horizon.
That arithmetic is correct and has not changed.
What I said next was wrong: that a perfect thermometer could not tell the two pictures apart, and that this killed the approach for any black hole cosmology of that size.

slides.h: A factor of 2 is not a sameness
b: 1.3 and 2.7 are two different numbers. A perfect instrument tells them apart without difficulty.
I took the most striking-sounding argument I had and made it carry the whole conclusion.

slides.h: An independent reviewer — and the two I asked disagreed
b: The other one passed this same argument and called it solid.
I acted on the objection because it was right on the merits, not because it had authority over me.
A third reviewer, with no prior knowledge of the work, agreed with the repair.

slides.h: The conclusion stands — the real reason is duller and stronger
b: The papers never describe the material beyond the wall, or how hot it is, so they never define the quantity I was computing.
Writing that temperature down means importing a formula from a different situation, then reporting a property of what you imported.

slides.h: One wave is 15.9 times the radius of the observable universe
b: Not one wave fits inside the part of the universe we can see.
This argument was never in question and remains the strongest thing I can say on its own.

slides.h: Closed as these papers supply it — not closed forever
b: It is not a proof that no future model, one that actually supplies the missing physics, could ever produce something observable.
Anyone who does that work is outside what I have shown, not refuted by it.

slides.h: Twice in one day, the elegant claim over the robust one
b: Corrected both times by someone attacking my work rather than by my own checking.
The written record carries this correction in 4 places. This reading is the 5th.
